neighbours.label: In English code docstrings or comments, the word 'order' in 'in order' / 'in the same order' when it says the items of one collection line up position by position with the items of another collection named just before; the same description ending some other way (a type, a unit, a format) stays quiet, and so does 'in order' about a single collection on its own.
neighbours.short: 'in (the same) order' aligning two collections in code docs

neighbours.notes: Test sentences written blind by a second author who saw only the label. play step ran out of GPU memory on the stream machine (resident model loaded), so the feeder was chosen as the top attribution feeder from the resident model, and no ablation drop or feeds edge is recorded. In probing, the pole was much stronger when the aligned collection was named first (keys then vals 'in order' ~1.0 vs a single collection ~0.1); prose was weaker (~0.26) and Spanish/French weak (~0.11).

predictions: most fire items 0.2-0.6; one-line fragments without a def signature may score lower than the probes did
